# `reentry`

Scenario kind of the engine v0.38.0, family [Mission analysis, links and space operations](../mission-analysis-links-and-space-operations.md). Advisory: analysis output from a research and engineering tool, not type-approved navigation equipment and not a safety-of-life service. Every label here is the engine's or the verification matrix's; a kind is MODELLED unless the matrix says otherwise (how a label is earned: the README's Evidence section).

## What it does

Allen-Eggers ballistic re-entry corridor: peak deceleration (ballistic-coefficient-independent, V_e^2 sin|γ|/(2eH)), the velocity and altitude at peak-g, and the peak-heating velocity, for an entry velocity/flight-path-angle/ballistic-coefficient through an exponential atmosphere, plus a planar point-mass integration of the same ballistic entry with gravity, Earth curvature and the US Standard Atmosphere 1976 (peak deceleration, speed, altitude and time at the peak). MODELLED ballistic (no-lift) entry; heating output is the peak-heating VELOCITY, not a heat-flux (no aerothermal/TPS model).

One run of `scenarios/reentry.toml` summarises as: reentry (Allen–Eggers): V_e 7800 m/s, γ 6.0° -> peak 16.6 g at 49 km, 4731 m/s; heating peaks at 6603 m/s; point mass (gravity, curvature, US76) peak 16.4 g (MODELLED ballistic, no aerothermal)
